title: REQ · buildEffects creates effect entities from scene content on the effects layer
summary: A pure buildEffects uses an injected effect context to create dust, light and play the fade
description: Add EffectRenderContext and buildEffects so effects are created from content without Phaser imports, at the effects layer depth.
acceptance_criteria: Given scene.effects with dust, ambientLight and fade, when buildEffects runs, then createEffect is called for dust and light with depth layerDepth('effects') and playTransition once with durationMs
Given no effects, when buildEffects runs, then nothing is created and an empty handle list returns
Given the returned handles, when destroyed, then each effect handle destroy is called
